constraints.area_constrained_seed_semantics: all skin faces with at least one exact Run029 159 crossing pair

solver.method: Global SCP with graph-Laplacian soft first-union targets for all current inside points, exact source/trust/exit projections, oriented-area guards on every Run029 face with a crossing plus the complete one-ring, and dynamic sparse self-pair barriers; every accepted iterate is also gated by a fresh complete exact 185-bank point audit requiring no new typed inside pairs and strict pair reduction

limitations: Construction geometry only. Finite ADMM partial iterates are proposal-only; convergence is not an acceptance criterion. Every backtracking trial is saved before gating. Frozen Run030 first-union targets cover all 1,417 Run029 inside nodes. Each accepted step passes exact self and fresh complete 185-bank point audits, with no new typed inside pairs and strict reduction. Run029 4,331 surface crossing-pair count seeds oriented-area guards but is not directly comparable after subdivision. The result has no anatomical, material, physical, or native admission.
